style: Warm, joyful hand-painted storybook illustration in the look of a 2D animated family film: soft painterly brush strokes, rounded friendly shapes, bright summery colours, warm golden light, gentle shadows, cosy and happy, cinematic widescreen composition. The two people are always the same: Tine and little Max exactly as in the reference sheets, and nobody else unless asked. No text, no letters, no borders.

cast.tine: Tine, a cheerful woman in her thirties: shoulder-length straight blond hair, sunglasses pushed up on her head, blue-grey eyes, a big warm open smile, white sleeveless top, beige shorts
cast.max: Max, a little boy about three or four: short light-blond hair, blue eyes, round cheeks, a huge laughing smile, a light blue striped shirt, a grey bandana bib, light green trousers

shots.scene: in a lush, friendly storybook jungle, giant leaves, vines, bright flowers, sunbeams, morning light through giant leaves, colourful birds, no people
